title: Consilience: Conformally Calibrated Communication Control for Hidden-Profile Multi-Agent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.20564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems can improve reasoning by pooling diverse perspectives, but their effectiveness depends on coordinating communication, particularly in hidden-profile settings where each agent holds only part of the evidence required for a correct decision. Existing protocols, including fixed schedules, round-robin exchange, and unstructured debate, provide no guarantee that a conversational action is appropriate. We propose Consilience, an inference-time orchestration framework that both steers and certifies multi-agent communication under distributed private information. At each turn, Consilience summarizes the discussion using a compact state capturing uncertainty, disagreement, evidence gain, redundancy, and premature consensus, then selects both a communication intervention (challenge, clarify, seek evidence, or route) and an appropriate speaker. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20564v1 公告类型：新 摘要：多智能体大语言模型系统通过汇集不同视角可以改善推理能力，但其有效性依赖于协调通信，尤其是在隐藏配置场景中，每个智能体仅持有正确决策所需的部分证据。现有协议，包括固定时间表、轮询交换和非结构化辩论，都无法保证对话行为是否合适。我们提出Consilience，一种推理时编排框架，在分布式私有信息下既引导又认证多智能体通信。在每一轮中，Consilience使用一个紧凑状态总结讨论，该状态捕捉不确定性、分歧、证据增益、冗余和过早共识，然后选择一种通信干预（质疑、澄清、寻求证据或路由）以及合适的发言者。其核心贡献是一种逐轮保形校准程序，该程序提供了...
tldr: 本文提出Consilience框架，通过逐轮保形校准来动态引导和认证多智能体通信，确保在隐藏配置场景中每个通信动作的适当性，从而提升多智能体推理的可靠性和有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Consilience, a framework that dynamically steers and certifies multi-agent communication via round-wise conformal calibration, ensuring appropriateness of each conversational action in hidden-profile settings to enhance reasoning reliability.
